room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day (SI up to ₹4L); Single Private Room (₹5L and above)
room_rent.note: Room limit depends on sum insured: up to 1% of base SI per day for ₹2L-₹4L; single private room for ₹5L and above. Higher room means proportionate deduction.

icu.note: ICU covered up to sum insured (Annexure I).

sub_limits.display: Mental disorders 10% SI/₹50k; modern treatments capped (robotic ₹2.5L etc.)
sub_limits.note: Listed mental disorders capped at 10% of base SI or ₹50,000. Modern treatments capped per procedure: robotic surgery ₹2.5L, stereotactic radiosurgery ₹3.5L, deep brain stimulation / immunotherapy / intravitreal injections ₹5L, bronchial thermoplasty ₹2L.

deductible.note: Mandatory annual aggregate deductible, chosen at purchase: E-saver ₹10,000 / ₹25,000 / ₹50,000, or Super Top-up ₹1 lakh to ₹10 lakh. Cover starts once claims in the year exceed it.

initial_waiting.note: 30 days for illness; accidents covered from day 1.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for listed conditions; accidents from day 1.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Loyalty Additions: 5% of base SI added each year, up to 50%, regardless of claims. Only for base SI up to ₹25 lakh.

restoration.note: The wording has no restoration or refill benefit.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance up to ₹1,500 per hospitalisation, one transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered; robotic surgery ₹2.5L, stereotactic radiosurgery ₹3.5L, deep brain stimulation / immunotherapy / intravitreal ₹5L, bronchial thermoplasty ₹2L.

consumables.note: Non-medical items in Annexure III List I are not payable; no add-on covers them.

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India is excluded (6.2 XI).

notable_exclusions.display: Top-up / super top-up with aggregate deductible (cover starts above deductible); maternity excluded (Excl18)

optional_riders.display: Personal Accident Cover, Critical Illness Cover, e-Consultation, room rent modification, deductible alteration (once/lifetime)
